question: Midway through Sochi 2014, US long-track speed skaters swapped their new high-tech suits for older ones. What followed?
answer: Still no medals. A team that had won four long-track medals in 2010 left Sochi with none, its first shut-out since 1984, in either suit. A review months later cleared the suit and blamed preparation, above all a final camp at altitude on an outdoor rink in Italy before an indoor, sea-level Games.
move: When removing the suspect changes nothing, it probably was not the cause.
trap: If the suits were to blame, dropping them should have fixed it.
